layer: P0 label-definition and annotation-readiness audit; exploratory; no method-effect evidence

source_project.execution_commit: recorded in the post-registration run receipt

research_question: Can a deterministic, privacy-preserving sample of packet-vs-canonical FK-definition disagreements be prepared for independent human judgment of intended FK mappings, conditional on a supplied table pair?
hypothesis: Frozen per-question crosswalk labels, canonical P1.5 diagnostics, and valid SQLite FK instances suffice to create reproducible blinded A/B packets with complete composite mappings and no Gold SQL or method provenance in the packets.
interpretation_boundary: Preparation only. No human review, trusted Role labels, Role Accuracy, SQL EX, or model-method gain is produced. Table pairs are derived from Gold JOIN structure, so this is a conditional mapping review, not an end-to-end or fully Gold-free online evaluation.

inputs.dataset: BIRD dev; repeatedly used development/diagnostic data; not an independent test set

sampling.selection: stable SHA-256 order per stratum, then deduplicate questions and preserve all selected stratum tags; no cross-stratum replacement

annotation.consensus: exact decision and mapping-set agreement, both reviewers confidence >= 2

execution.command_template: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' OMP_NUM_THREADS=8 MKL_NUM_THREADS=8 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=8 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=8 conda run --no-capture-output -n think2sql_20260909 python3.12 scripts/text2sql/prepare_p0_fk_disagreement_review_packet.py --mode {smoke|full} --run-id {run_id} --dev-json ${BIRD_DEV_ROOT}/dev.json --tables-json ${BIRD_DEV_ROOT}/dev_tables.json --fk-artifact ${P1_5_FK_ARTIFACT} --crosswalk-private ${CROSSWALK_PRIVATE} --canonical-full ${CANONICAL_FULL} --output-dir ${P0_RESULT_ROOT}/{smoke|full}/{run_id}

success_and_stop_gates.smoke: all input hashes and frozen stratum population counts match; 5 deterministic selected cases parse; packets render in memory; candidate mapping sets agree across A/B; no SQL or method provenance is emitted
success_and_stop_gates.full: all smoke gates plus 1534 question-key joins, exact quotas, at least 30 unique questions, complete parseable table-pair prompts, full valid FK mapping lists, private permissions, and output hashes
